description: S4. Magda, Brazen Outlaw with Clock of Omens and Liquimetal Torque on magda's turn (pod n7WpsqsZtdQ). The loop: Torque makes Magda an artifact; Clock taps Magda and a Treasure to untap Magda; Magda becoming tapped makes a Treasure; repeat for any number of tapped Treasures, then sacrifice them five at a time to Magda to put every artifact onto the battlefield, Grinding Station among them (each Treasure entering untaps Station, which mills 3 per artifact sacrificed). Tests an activated loop with a flagged piece (Clock of Omens carries AI:RemoveDeck:All; 0 activations of a printed Clock in 135 battlefield entries in the corpus) and the human Magda game-2 win. Success: magda wins by turn 12 (the opponents lose drawing from empty libraries on their turns 10 to 12).
notes: The finisher is in the library, not on the board: Commander Spellbook's line produces infinite Treasures and 'put all artifact cards onto the battlefield', and Grinding Station is magda's own artifact that turns that into a mill kill. A pilot that loops Clock but never searches still shows up in the activation counts.
The report counts Clock and Torque activations and Magda triggers per turn; the loop running is iterations well above 5 in the scenario turn.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
